goal: Verify and repair the Agent Host runtime contract so read-only/no-push task envelopes cannot be executed with full_autonomy/git_push/write_worktree permissions.
objective: Run a server-side review of the deployed Agent Host generic runner and the current PR #83 runner-contract branch. The latest GoMesh read-only supervision task completed without changes, but result.json still showed permission_packs=['full_autonomy'] and permissions including git_push/write_worktree for a read_only envelope. Determine whether the deployed runtime is missing the PR #83 fix, whether PR #83 is sufficient, or whether an additional repair PR is required. Do not mutate production services. Do not deploy or restart Agent Host. Product code changes are allowed only on a dedicated repair branch if the review proves PR #83 does not already cover the runtime gap.

review_targets.expected_contract: read_only or git_push_forbidden envelopes must not receive full_autonomy, git_push, write_worktree, service_restart, deploy, or other write permissions in the final permission pack.

expected_actions: Inspect the source result.json from the GoMesh read-only task and confirm the permission-pack violation without printing secrets.
Compare deployed Agent Host behavior with PR #83 head if accessible.
Run focused tests or static harnesses for permission sanitization.
If PR #83 already fixes the issue, report that the blocker is deployment/post-merge canary rather than new code.
If PR #83 does not fix it, create a dedicated repair branch and draft PR limited to Agent Host permission-pack enforcement and tests.
Do not restart or deploy Agent Host in this task.
Create exact canonical run artifacts with decision and next canary/deploy task.
acceptance: Remote execution happens on a server node, not Mac.
The GoMesh read-only permission-pack evidence is explicitly classified.
The decision is explicit: already_fixed_by_pr83_needs_deploy_canary, repair_pr_created, blocked, or false_positive.
If code changes are made, they are limited to Agent Host runner contract scope and tests.
Final result includes branch/PR if created, tests, blockers and next exact runtime canary/deploy task.
